summary: Iteration 186 — Receivables reports (Collection, TDS, Retention) + TDS certificate + Receipt drill enrichment. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass at /app/backend/tests/test_iter186_receivables.py (unfiltered collection totals ₹5,91,600 across 20 receipts / TDS ₹6,400; filters by client/mode/date-range verified as subsets; monthly trend buckets have month+amount+count; CSV exports return text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment and header row; PATCH /receipts/{id}/tds-certificate marks + clears cert, returns 404 for unknown id and 400 for zero-TDS receipt; receipt drill enriches with journal_entry.lines + invoices; sales@erp.com correctly 403 on collection/tds/retention/patch). Frontend: admin login → Accounts → Collection Report shows KPI tiles, Monthly Collection Trend bars and 20-row table; This month filter narrows KPI to ₹2,04,600 and Clear restores ₹5,91,600; clicking coll-row-RCPT-2026-0010 opens receipt-drill-dialog with Journal Entry + Linked Invoices sections; Export downloads collection_report.csv. TDS Receivable page has tds-fy-filter, tds-cert-filter, tds-export-btn, 6 tds-cert-btn-* rows; cert dialog opens, saving with cert no shows 'Export downloaded/toast' feedback and cert filter can be switched; TDS CSV downloads. Retention Receivable page CSV also downloads. No console errors on any of the three pages.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_router.py is now 964 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting the /reports/* endpoints and _csv_response/_fy_quarter/_receipt_query helpers into billing_reports_router.py for maintainability.

collection_report() loads up to 5000 receipts unindexed and does the trend/by_client aggregation in Python. For >5k receipts scale this to a MongoDB aggregate pipeline. Same applies to tds_receivable_report and retention_receivable_report.

set_tds_certificate() writes tds_certificate as {} when payload.received is False (line 880). Consider {'received': False, 'cleared_at': now_iso(), 'cleared_by': ...} for auditability — right now the audit-log delta records after={} which loses the 'who cleared it' info.
collection_report_export() does not honour the same 5000 cap intent — a very large query silently truncates. Consider streaming or explicit ceiling warning header.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all inner-nav pages, filters, drill-down, cert save, and 3 CSV downloads succeeded)
